headline: Crude Oil Prices Decline Following US Inventory Build
summary: Brent crude dropped to $92.49 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate fell to $84.73 following an American Petroleum Institute report showing stockpiles built across crude and fuels, despite Middle East tensions.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy benchmark that impacts inflation expectations, transport costs, and central bank policy worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Prices dropped after API reported builds across crude and fuel inventories.
